The Mechanism

Native icebergs (Binance ‘icebergQty’, OKX ‘iceberg algos*)
are a sequence of small orders. Each visible ‘peak refill’ enters
the back of the queue.

Deep queues punish small peaks twice (slower fills, adverse selection).

Exposure buys fills but pays in impact (Bessembinder et al.).

class SliceTactic:
def p_star(self, spread: float, tau: float) -> float:
delta = self.cfg.adverse_frac * self.cfg.sigma_1s * math.sqrt(tau)
prize = spread + self.fees.taker - self.fees.maker
return delta / (prize + delta)

def on_tick(self, t, bid, ask, queue_ahead, drain):
# ... logic omitted ...
if self.state == State. IDLE:

if self.p_fill(queue_ahead, drain, remain) >=
self.p_star(ask - bid, remain) >=
self.p_star(ask - bid, remain):
self.state, self.px = State.POSTED, touch
else:
return [(("post", touch, left)]

self.state = State. CROSSING
return [("cross", left) ]
